info.title: Vinplus backend API proposal
info.description: Proposed contract for the frontend at b0873bd. No backend is deployed. Review business definitions, identity, provider eligibility, limits and mappings with backend-handoff.md before implementation. Provider webhooks and OAuth callbacks are separate server-to-server protocols, intentionally excluded from this browser API.

sessionCookie.name: vinplus_session
sessionCookie.description: Example HttpOnly Secure session cookie; agree actual identity and CSRF design with the backend.

embedToken.name: X-Embed-Token
embedToken.description: Revocable embed capability scoped to one explicitly published snapshot; never accepts arbitrary frontend config as authorization.

Decimal.description: Exact decimal amount; do not convert to formatted currency or round before aggregation.

Status.description: Proposed stable enum matching current labels; final business policy must be agreed.

Selection.description: Every selection is an AND predicate. Keep independent owners even when their field is the same. Null represents missing values.

QueryContext.description: Identity and allowed dealer scope come from the authenticated session, never this body.

Sort.description: Server must allowlist fields per view, and apply a stable ID tie-breaker before pagination.

Summary.description: Summary of the complete authorized query, not just a paginated table page. Percentages are percentage points, not fractions.

MetricBucket.description: Return all fields required by the chart in handoff section 6. Count aliases in the current renderer must not be mistaken for amounts. Required measures are never silently omitted.

ChartQuery.description: Only manager supports level 2. dealerOrders, vinOrders and salesMix have no inline detail level. records uses record rows.

SnapshotCreate.description: Server derives the title and validates permissions. Live query and frozen result behavior must be agreed explicitly.

UploadAuthorization.description: Backend validates completed object before allowing a note to reference it; an upload URL is not a public download URL.

ConnectRequest.description: Server additionally allowlists the return path; never accept arbitrary redirect URLs.

ShareResult.description: Per-target outcomes allow partial success. Queued is not delivered.

Message.description: Direction is relative to the authenticated participant. Do not invent delivery/read receipts absent provider evidence.

MessageCreate.description: Require either a nonempty allowed body or an approved template. Server verifies eligibility and resolves template data; ordinary bodies cannot bypass the WhatsApp window.
